hypothesis: The option to wait exactly one completed legal minute before a fixed raw-share cash-to-SOXX or cash-to-SOXL buy has positive fee-net five-session local value relative to acting at the first legal minute on the dated cap-free lock parent. This is an economic timing target, not a predictive minute feature or a candidate strategy.
closed_route_distinction: Old cash timing used old beta-capped cash-to-SOXX and a 15-minute VWAP proxy; this card uses the new single raw-share dual-asset five-session same-state lock labels and tests a fixed one-bar wait without fitting, threshold selection, or later-year outcome access.
decision_rule: For each day, compare first and immediately next chronological source-eligible completed-minute intent, exactly one minute apart. At the first clock, NOW submits its frozen raw-share order for next-bar fill; WAIT holds one minute and at the next clock recomputes the same fixed-beta raw-share intent from then-known parent state for next-bar fill. Both are separate branch labels with identical five-session terminal date. No future-funded filter is an online action input.
pair_admissibility: Both saved labels must be mature; both from same phase, have one-minute adjacent bar_end_at, positive first decision NAV and HOLD terminal NAV parity <=1e-7 USD. Keep unknown/no-fill source counts; attempt_no_fill is economically zero-valued, not silently dropped.
value: For each asset, (WAIT_local_value*WAIT_decision_nav - NOW_local_value*NOW_decision_nav)/NOW_decision_nav. This compares USD terminal increments from the same HOLD terminal NAV, not raw percentages with different denominators. Report fees and share differences separately; price path remains confounded with share sizing.
all_minute_diagnostic: Report count and distribution of every mature adjacent same-phase minute pair under the same HOLD parity, but only first-pair day values enter the fixed information gate; no hindsight best-minute action or hour selection.
stop: Any source/hash/clock/HOLD parity failure stops. A failed fixed one-bar timing gate closes only this WAIT policy; no delay length, year, asset, threshold, sign or bootstrap rescue. An economic pass only permits a separately frozen decision-time information test, not a SOXX account.
